lean_snippet.content:
theorem e_91_long_composite_run (k : Nat) (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∃ n, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range k, ¬ (n + i).Prime := by
  refine ⟨(k + 1)! + 2, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hi' : i < k := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  have hj : 2 ≤ i + 2 := by omega
  have hj' : i + 2 ≤ k + 1 := by omega
  have hdiv : i + 2 ∣ (k + 1)! + (i + 2) := by
    have hfact : i + 2 ∣ (k + 1)! := Nat.dvd_factorial hj' (by omega)
    exact Nat.dvd_add hfact (Nat.dvd_refl _)
  have hne : 1 < i + 2 := by omega
  exact Nat.not_prime_iff.mpr ⟨i + 2, hne, hdiv⟩

nodes.statement: Every tree with n >= 2 has at least two leaves.
nodes.plain_summary: Lemma `GT-LM-BC-TR-022` (graph in combinatorics): Every tree with n >= 2 has at least two leaves. This claim is discharged in Lean or via a closed specimen. Gap kind `axiom_layer` — see provability backlog. Proof technique tag: `lean_discharge`.

lean_snippet.content:
theorem gt_lm_bc_tr_022 (G : SimpleGraph V) [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nontrivial V]
    (ht : G.IsTree) : 2 ≤ #{v | G.degree v = 1} := by
  classical
  let leaves := Finset.univ.filter fun v => G.degree v = 1
  have hdeg_lb : ∀ v ∈ leavesᶜ, 2 ≤ G.degree v := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [leaves, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_compl] at hv
    have hne : G.degree v ≠ 1 := by
      intro hdeg
      exact hv fun h => by simpa [leaves, hdeg] using h
    have hpos : 0 < G.degree v :=
      G.degree_pos_iff_exists_adj.mpr (ht.connected.exists_adj v)
    omega
  have hsum_lb : 2 * Fintype.card V - leaves.card ≤ ∑ v, G.degree v := by
    calc ∑ v, G.degree v
        = ∑ v ∈ leaves, G.degree v + ∑ v ∈ leavesᶜ, G.degree v := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_union, Finset.union_compl, Finset.sum_univ]
          exact Finset.disjoint_compl_left
      _ ≥ leaves.card + 2 * (Fintype.card V - leaves.card) := by
          gcongr
          · exact fun v hv => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
          · exact fun v hv => hdeg_lb v hv
      _ = 2 * Fintype.card V - leaves.card := by ring
  have hsum_eq : ∑ v, G.degree v = 2 * Fintype.card V - 2 := by
    rw [G.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges, ht.card_edgeFinset, Finset.card_univ]
  omega
